dedupe_keys.name: xu water network flow and pressure imputation datasets

description: Ang Xu and coauthors released four water-distribution sensor datasets with their imputation study. The data record has a versioned Zenodo DOI and CC-BY-4.0 licence. The paper describes real flow observations from 63 sensors over one year and real pressure from 52 sensors over six months in an anonymised northern Chinese city. It also describes simulated flow and pressure series from 120 and 52 sensor locations over two months. All four use 15-minute intervals. The real series contain missing readings; the simulated series support controlled missing-data tests. The GitHub repository exposes CSV files, while Zenodo archives the cited paper dataset. This review opened metadata and the paper’s dataset description but did not inspect any CSV rows or download the 9.2 MB archive. Units, exact column labels, anonymisation and missing-value encodings should be checked before use. A modeller could calibrate sensor-gap handling or test whether incomplete pressure and flow inputs distort a network simulation. Related catalogue resource data-uky-water-distribution-system-research-database offers a separate water-system research collection; this release is specific to sensor imputation and does not include a verified complete asset inventory.
